title: Inquiry Customer Notification Center & Partner SLA Escalation

changes.details: Additive migration adding email_opt_in, sms_opt_in, notification_preferences, escalated_at, escalation_reason, escalation_count columns and indexes to rbpc_inquiries.
Added notification preferences, opt-in flags, and partner escalation fields to RbpcInquiry model.

Added RbpcInquiryNotificationPreferenceUpdate, RbpcInquiryNotificationPreferenceOut, RbpcInquiryEscalationCreate, RbpcInquiryEscalationOut schemas and extended RbpcInquiryStatusOut and RbpcInquiryCreate with opt-in preferences.
Implemented dispatch_inquiry_escalation, update_inquiry_notification_preferences, and unsubscribe_inquiry_notifications with zero-PII and zero-fake-sent guarantees.

Added POST /status/{opaqueToken}/preferences, POST /status/{opaqueToken}/unsubscribe, POST /status/{opaqueToken}/escalate, and enriched GET /status/{opaqueToken} with customer notification center data.
Updated InquiryStatusResponse with opt-in, SLA overdue, and escalation fields; added notification preference and escalation interfaces.
Added updateInquiryNotificationPreferences, unsubscribeInquiryNotifications, and escalateInquiryLateResponse API functions.
Integrated Customer Notification Center in the tracking view with live Email/SMS toggle badges, one-click unsubscribe, overdue SLA warning badge, and partner escalation form.

10 comprehensive unit and integration tests verifying tracking status zero PII, preference updates, unsubscribe, 24h SLA overdue escalation, cooldown throttling, and negative abuse network error handling.

invariants.negative_abuse_provider_resilience: VERIFIED - Network timeouts or connection drops during partner notification dispatch never show or send fake confirmed/delivered status
invariants.zero_pii: VERIFIED - Status queries disclose zero contact names, emails, phones, or internal notes
invariants.sla_escalation: VERIFIED - Partner late escalation strictly enforces >24h SLA deadline and rate limit cooldown
